I Was so Blind. I blame me Aldric Chen 5 min read · Just now -- Listen Share Press enter or click to view image in full size Seen the writing on your wall? Photo by Vitaly Gariev on Unsplash Stress fractures can suddenly appear everywhere. That happens when you have your head down at work. And that is common. Time flies. We barely notice a thing. If that is you, don’t worry. Many people are the same. Me included. I have been focused on the sales pipeline and justifying sales projections, and I haven't noticed the stress cracks around me. They were [suddenly] all around me when I looked up. And it turns out that our product team has been flashing warning signs… Of software, roadmap, product backlog, and overwhelming bugs. In the world of software, your product roadmap matters. The product team manages new feature releases, product bugs collated from users, patches deployed, and big-picture planning for product evolution and revolution. In short, the product team charts the firm’s future. In their heyday, the [software] product lead calls the shots. They decide and assess features to enhance, drop, or introduce.
